records.claim: Studies have not been done to see if mycophenolate could affect a man’s fertility (ability to get a woman pregnant). Three studies looking at 356 infants born to men taking mycophenolate around the time of conception found no increase in birth defects. Another report including 255 children born to men taking mycophenolate also showed no increase in miscarriage or birth defects.
records.source_section: If a man takes mycophenolate, could it affect fertility or increase the chance of birth defects?
